acceptance.assertion: For domain agent.ledger, event_id is the stable delivery identity: replaying the same event_id with canonically identical event content succeeds without appending another ledger record, while the same event_id with different canonical content fails closed with an explicit conflict.

Single-event, batch and concurrent requests validate all candidate identities and conflicts under the ledger write boundary so a conflict cannot leave a partially applied ambiguous batch or weaken append-only storage semantics.

A producer crash, timeout or lost HTTP response after remote acceptance but before local receipt commit can be retried and converges to one ledger record per event_id without data loss or duplicate appends.

The snapshot-bound Chronik outbox introduced through chronik PR 240 can retain and advance exact source-prefix receipts; a retry without a receipt is safe because the remote agent.ledger contract is idempotent, and a later appended suffix remains independently pending.
Idempotent event_id handling is restricted to agent.ledger. Existing ingestion and conflict behavior for all other Chronik domains remains unchanged unless separately reviewed and evidenced.

The HTTP boundary returns stable success and conflict semantics that distinguish accepted new events, identical replays and conflicting identities without exposing raw ledger content or claiming exactly-once transport.

Focused fault-injection and concurrency tests, the complete Chronik validation suite, GitHub CI and an exact-head local or isolated live smoke prove first delivery, identical replay, conflicting replay, mixed new/duplicate batch and ambiguous-completion recovery.

approval.note: Direct user instruction on 2026-07-30 authorized implementing the promoted Chronik delivery-idempotency follow-up. Registry publication remains independently gated by reviewed_plan.

goal: Make agent.ledger delivery converge without duplicate or lost ledger events when Chronik accepts a batch but the producer times out, crashes or loses the response before a local source-prefix receipt is durably committed, while preserving append-only ledger truth and leaving all other domains unchanged.

metadata.finding: PR 240 prevents stale-receipt data loss and sends only unacknowledged suffixes, but the existing agent.ledger HTTP ingest path is not idempotent when remote acceptance succeeds before local receipt persistence.
metadata.source_request: Direct user instruction on 2026-07-30 to implement the promoted Chronik follow-up.

rollback.procedure: Restore the previous ingestion path, preserve all existing ledger bytes and failure evidence, quarantine only derived idempotency state if introduced, and require a fresh integrity readback before retrying delivery.
rollback.trigger: The implementation duplicates events, suppresses a conflicting payload, partially commits a conflicting batch, changes non-agent.ledger behavior or requires rewriting existing ledger history.

conditions: a foreign Chronik task, lease, process or worktree overlaps the selected implementation paths
the design requires rewriting, deleting or normalizing previously valid ledger records
identical replay and conflicting replay cannot be distinguished from canonical event content
batch conflict handling cannot remain fail-closed under concurrent writers
the change would silently alter ingestion semantics for domains other than agent.ledger

title: Make Chronik agent-ledger delivery idempotent across ambiguous completion
